_doc: Smoke config for the R2LPL reproducer stage (rlvr.autoresearch.tools.mine_direct_reproducer_chunks) on a v1 dataset's contiguous corpus. By DEFAULT runs plan_only: loads the contiguous NPZs, detects the rollout lineage, plans chunks, and validates timeline continuity (planned_chunks>=1) - self-contained, needs no external asset. To exercise the full closed-loop MODEL rollout (simulated_chunks>=1, native realized CL reward), set danger_reward_config to a reward config path; the threshold/credit configs default to the in-repo ones. The reward config is an internal asset (not committed), so plan_only is the committed default.
